Bill.BriefDescription: Adding a certain ferry route and roads to the scenic and recreational highway system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an addition to the scenic and recreationalhighway system; and amending RCW 47.39.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.39.020 and 2003 c 55 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:
